root_cause: Exact production SHA and connector readiness were already proven, but the generic targeted route verifier hit a single Playwright TimeoutError waiting for body visibility on /prijzen. The verifier retried page.goto timeouts but not the subsequent body-ready phase, so a transient edge/page-readiness race prevented the pricing-specific browser proof from running.
prevention_rule: Production route verification may retry only transient Playwright TimeoutError failures during navigation/body readiness, using a fresh page each attempt and a small bounded backoff. All non-timeout errors and exhaustion after three attempts remain terminal failures.
terminal_rule: LIVE_BEWEZEN only after protected merge and a successful exact-production route plus pricing/i18n browser readback.
